name: std::condition_variable_any::condition_variable_any
intro:
1) Constructs an object of type std::condition_variable_any.

2) Copy constructor is deleted.

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text: 1) May throw std::system_error with std::error_condition equal to std::errc::operation_not_permitted if the thread has no privilege to create a condition variable, std::errc::resource_unavailable_try_again if a non-memory resource limitation prevents this initialization, or another implementation-defined value.

examples.title: Practical use case
examples.input: Run the self-contained program; assertions check the documented behavior.
